package: one Leshy2 bundle with target-bound S3, C5, RP2354B, pack-MSPM0 and safety-MSPM0 images plus one compatibility manifest

signature_contract.status: algorithm and exact C1106 verifier remain build-size and fault-injection closure gates

preconditions: qualified USB power is stable and battery policy permits flash writes
every target and cross-domain protocol range matches the connected hardware
activation_order: stage and read-back verify every inactive image before activating any of them
activate and self-test pack MSPM0, safety MSPM0, C5 and RP2354B while S3 remains the known-good coordinator
commit the bundle only after every domain reports its own build ID and health result
deadline_basis: complete identification, self-test and commit must fit below the fixed 16.7-second RP2350 TBYB watchdog window
failure_policy: a failed target returns to its local last-known-good image; the known-good S3 coordinator then returns any already advanced peer to the bundle's compatible previous image
